summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a browser Vue chat UI (a pre-built UMD is already shipped in dist/richWebChat.umd.min.js), but declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip, chmods the extracted Bun binary executable, and then invokes it against a bundled 727KB file math_init.js that begins with the marker `// @bun @bun-cjs` and consists of a hex-encoded shuffled string array with an in-place rotation decoder. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style transforms (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, property-wrapper objects). The package's stated purpose has no need for the Bun runtime or a compiled Bun blob at install time; the combination — install-time download of an alternate language runtime plus execution of a sibling opaque obfuscated payload — is an alternate-runtime dropper that hands arbitrary code execution on the installer machine to whoever controls the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
